name: soil-handover
description: The Soil Handover Specification and its official implementations: save the project state, load it anywhere, see what survived.

scripts.conformance: tsc -b && node conformance/dist/run.js && python3 conformance/run_py.py && go run -C conformance/go . && packages/sdk-jvm/gradlew -p packages/sdk-jvm :conformance:run --quiet && dotnet run --project conformance/dotnet
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm test:py && pnpm conformance && pnpm conformance:interop
